Issue: Owlonius is implemented with the engine SPELLPOWER_DOUBLE tag (update = Refresh(CONTROLLER, {GameTag.SPELLPOWER_DOUBLE: 1})). In player.get_spell_damage the result is computed as (amount + spellpower) << spellpower_double, which doubles the ENTIRE spell-damage figure including the spell's base damage. With Owlonius on board (Spell Damage +1) a 6-damage Fireball deals (6+1)<<1 = 14.
Real behaviour: Owlonius reads 'Your spells get double bonus from Spell Damage' â€” only the bonus from Spell Damage is doubled, not the base damage. With +1 Spell Damage the bonus becomes +2, so a 6-damage Fireball should deal 6 + 2 = 8, not 14. The SPELLPOWER_DOUBLE tag is the wrong primitive (it models Prophet-Velen-style 'double all spell damage').
Fix: d2fe8eae — TOY_807 now uses the SPELLPOWER_BONUS_DOUBLE tag and player.get_spell_damage doubles only the Spell Damage bonus, not the base; test asserts a +1 Spell Damage 6-dmg spell deals 8, not 14.

Issue: Implemented as `play = ForceDraw(CONTROLLER, RANDOM(FRIENDLY_DECK + MINION)).then(Find(ForceDraw.TARGET + PIRATE) & Give(CONTROLLER, "GAME_005"))`. Two consequences verified at runtime: (1) the draw is NOT restricted to minions â€” with only a spell (Moonfire) in deck it draws the spell; (2) `ForceDraw.TARGET` resolves to the Player, so `Find(Player + PIRATE)` is always empty and the Coin is NEVER granted even when the drawn card is a Pirate (drew Southsea Deckhand -> 0 Coins).

Fix: eea8ccbf — Draw(player,selector) (not ForceDraw, which drops the selector): minion-restricted draw + Coin gates on the drawn card being a Pirate

Issue: The effect is scripted as `play = Draw(...).then(Buff(...))` on a Location card. Locations should script their effect under `activate =`, which fires only on use(). Because UseLocation falls back to running the `play` script when no `activate` exists, the draw fires BOTH at play time AND on each subsequent use(). Verified: after loc.play() a battlecry minion is already drawn into hand with -1 cost; using the location later draws a second one. Net effect: one extra free draw the printed card never grants, and the play-time draw breaks the Location's intended deferred-charge semantics.
Real behaviour: Fairy Tale Forest is a 3-Cost Location with 3 charges. It does nothing when played; each USE draws a Battlecry minion that costs (1) less. The fix is to rename the script attribute from `play` to `activate` so the engine only runs it on use().
Fix: 5106a84f — script moved from play to activate so the discounted Battlecry-minion draw fires on Location use(), not on play; test asserts no draw on play and a draw on use.

Issue: The card script correctly grants 2 random Frost spells and flags both with the TEMPORARY tag (verified: both c.temporary == True). However, when the turn ends, the engine's EndTurn.do (fireplace/actions.py ~line 548: `for card in player.hand: if card.temporary: card.discard()`) iterates the live hand list while card.discard() mutates it, so when the two temporary spells sit at adjacent indices the second is skipped and survives. Root cause is the engine end-of-turn loop, not the TOY_307 script, but it manifests directly on this card (the first card in the set to grant 2 temporary cards at once). Fix: snapshot the list, e.g. `for card in list(player.hand): ...`.
Real behaviour: Both temporary Frost spells should be discarded from hand at the end of the turn (they are one-turn cards). Currently one survives.
Fix: d2fe8eae — EndTurn.do now snapshots the hand (`for card in list(player.hand)`) so adjacent temporary cards are no longer skipped; both temporary Frost spells now discard. Test rewritten to seed RNG and assert both vanish at end of turn while the non-temporary Mini token survives.

Issue: Cleave is wired as events = Attack(SELF).on(CLEAVE) where CLEAVE = Hit(TARGET_ADJACENT, ATK(SELF)). TARGET_ADJACENT = ADJACENT(TARGET) and TARGET = source.target. During a live attack the attacker stores its target in attack_target, not target (card.target stays None), so TARGET_ADJACENT resolves to ADJACENT(None) = [] and no adjacent minions take damage. Verified live: Gnomelia attacking the middle of three enemies hits only the defender; both flanking Wisps survive. Engine-wide limitation affecting every cleave-on-attack minion (Enslaved Fel Lord, Foe Reaper, Stonebound Gargon); the existing castle_nathria test only checks wiring for the same reason. The Deathrattle (Hit(ENEMY_CHARACTERS, 2)) works correctly.
Real behaviour: Rush. Also damages minions next to whomever this attacks (deal Gnomelia's Attack to the two minions flanking the defender). Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to all enemies. Currently the adjacent splash never fires on attack.
Fix: eea8ccbf — CLEAVE now reads ATTACK_TARGET_ADJACENT (defender lives in source.attack_target during an attack), fixing all cleave-on-attack minions
